cross_lane.reason: The slideshow lock/move is NOT in VHDIndependentBattle's stage 100: stage 100 only does StartQuest VEnding (line 17). VEndingScript's GameMode block then (quest script, ambient) disables companions, PipBoyRadioOff, SetInCharGen 1, DisablePlayerControls 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 and Player.MoveTo PlayerSlideshowMarker. The existing SlideshowEnd rule on VHDIndependentBattle therefore never sees those effects. Rules must live on VEnding and need C2; timeout_s must exceed the slideshow length (the default 120 s would release the lock mid-slideshow).

proposals.name: stages
proposals.justification: RulesEngine looks rules up per quest and applies them to EVERY SetStage/txn of that quest. VMQYesMan01 spans Tops (stage 0 via topic049) and Lucky 38 (70/75/80/100); VHDIndependentBattle stage 10 needs a warp while stage 100 needs the slideshow lock and 20-90 need nothing. A `stages: [N,...]` list lets one rule fire only where the script justifies it and removes the 120 s timeout deadlock class.

proposals.name: ReadyCheck
proposals.justification: The Yes Man point of no return is a message box (VEndGameWarningMsgIndy) whose button is read by `GetButtonPressed` in YesManDeadSCRIPT's GameMode block on the HOST; only after Button == 1 does it teleport, autosave and SetStage VHDIndependentBattle 10. Barrier (all-players-pass) cannot express this: it defers a SetStage, but the teleport happens BEFORE the stage. Needs C6.

proposals.name: scene_scripts
proposals.justification: C1 expressed declaratively: name the object scripts whose blocks run inside a capture scope attributed to a quest so that the quest's rules (PartyWarp, SaveSuppress, SetPlayerControls) see their effects.
